description: Infill extension over part of the existing building to provide additional floorspace at first floor level, with associated external alterations
decision_conditions: The proposal would, by reason of its positioning, scale, bulk and proximity to the nearby dwellings at the upper floors at no.78 High Street, be an intrusive, overbearing and unneighbourly development that would have a significant adverse effect on the amenities of these adjacent occupiers resulting in an overbearing impact, sense of enclosure, loss of outlook and overshadowing contrary to Policy 7 of the Havering Local Plan and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, it was necessary to issue a decision as close to the statutory timeframe as possible as opposed to seeking amendments which would have significantly delayed the application.
In the event that this application is allowed through the appeals process the proposals would be liable for the following CIL contributions:
Mayoral CIL (MCIL2) contribution of £2300 (x £25 per sqm).
Havering CIL (HCIL) contribution of £11500 (x £125 per sqm).
Each contribution would be subject to indexation.
